research_scope: Official model cards, file inventories, library documentation, and upstream license files; source inspection of the current browser prototype. This research did not download weights or run inference.

selected_model.license_evidence: Google's model page explicitly identifies License: apache-2.0. The Xenova card explicitly identifies that model as the source of its Transformers.js-compatible ONNX weights; the conversion card does not separately state another license.

weight_size.qualification: Rounded file-list values, not measured transfer totals or peak memory. Model weights exclude tokenizer/configuration files, JavaScript, WASM, and other runtime assets. Combined and split files are alternative layouts, not additive requirements.

browser_stack.execution: Dedicated module worker; single WASM thread; serialized inference requests.
browser_stack.input: User File or demo image passed as a Blob to the worker and then to the pipeline.

official_sources.supports: Vanilla JavaScript without a bundler; documented CDN import pinned to 3.8.1.
Browser inference through ONNX Runtime; WASM CPU backend and q8 support.
Zero-shot image classification ranks supplied candidate labels; accepted image inputs include Blob.
Specific Transformers.js zero-shot image-classification example and a photo of {} hypothesis template.
Browser cache configuration and local/remote model-loading controls.

candidate_labels: a path or an outdoor street
product_behavior.output: Highest-ranked theme selects a prewritten observation card; the interface shows the top three matches and offers manual correction.
product_behavior.card_copy: Prewritten in app.js; not model-generated at inference time. No claim that the copy was exclusively human-written.

cost_and_network.initial_download: Approximately 211 MB of q8 model weights plus runtime and configuration assets.
cost_and_network.qualification: No paid API is used by the architecture. Network access, download time, available storage, and device compute are still required; this is not a guarantee about hosting terms or a user's connectivity costs.

offline_and_device_limits.service_worker_scope: Allowed public runtime/model dependencies only. The page shell, same-origin scripts/photos, credentials, user photos, and cards are not cached by this service worker.
offline_and_device_limits.qualification: Browser cache support is not evidence that an entire page can be reloaded offline. Actual behavior is subject to cache eviction, quota, browser features, and the hosting environment.

reported_validation.source: Implementation agent's observed desktop localhost browser run; not a hosted deployment. Further functional checks are recorded in validation.json.
reported_validation.image: dist/assets/demo-leaf.jpg, a public-source leaf photograph that also contains water
reported_validation.qualification: One observed run, not an accuracy estimate, comparative benchmark, mobile test, offline test, outdoor field trial, or user study. Additional validation is to be recorded separately when performed.

publication_status.current_preview: Public hosted desktop model run verified on October 11, 2026; see validation.json for scope.

alternative_reviewed_not_selected.selection_reason: CLIP's upstream repository is MIT, but the reviewed upstream and conversion model cards did not explicitly state a separate weight license. SigLIP was selected because the upstream model card explicitly declares Apache-2.0. This records the research evidence boundary, not a claim that CLIP weights are prohibited.
